With the ridge mapper at its selected k=20, **Llama 3.1 8B→70B transfer reaches 57.78% on MMLU and 14.78% on GSM8K** (Table 13, p. 18).

The 70B target's own standalone scores are 78.84% on MMLU and 81.12% on GSM8K (p. 18). The transfer therefore keeps 73.3% of standalone MMLU accuracy and 18.2% of standalone GSM8K accuracy (Table 1, p. 6).

For comparison, the 8B source model alone scores higher on both: 64.97% on MMLU and 56.10% on GSM8K (p. 18).
